draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.34, the 42nd-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 2nd of 18 at S. He lasted until pick 118, well after his grade rank (42nd): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 55 tackles in 2024, 17th of 18 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Atlanta Falcons. 6 career games and 1 starts over 1 completed season, plus 2 so far in 2026. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: passer rating allowed 76.0 (82nd percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 21.2% (1st percentile), approximate value 1 (11th percentile). Played 6 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 safety who played: 27.2% season snap share against a median of 24.1%, above the norm.
